title: Small & Micro Wedding Venues in Houston, With Prices
description: 11 small and micro wedding venues in Houston, $197 to $8,900, each price from the venue's own site. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
h1: Small & micro wedding venues in Houston
eyebrow: Houston · prices from the venues' own pages
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, small wedding venues in Houston start at $380 for a group of 10 or more (The Middleton Venue). Couple-only chapels start at $197, and the 11 venues we verified go up to $8,900.

Each price and guest count is quoted from the venue's own website and shows the day we read it.

faq.q: What are the best venues for a micro wedding in Houston?
faq.a: We do not rank venues; we list the ones that print a small-group price on their own website. The three lowest are The Courthouse Wedding Chapel $197 (2 guests); The Middleton Venue $380 (seats up to 40); The Makenzie House (Little Glass Chapel) $499 (up to 20 guests), with 11 priced venues in all, from $197 to $8,900.

faq.q: What are some cheap wedding venues in Houston under $1,000?
faq.a: 6 of the 11 venues print a price under $1,000: The Courthouse Wedding Chapel $197; The Middleton Venue $380; The Makenzie House (Little Glass Chapel) $499; Houston Botanic Garden: Global Collection Garden $500. Prices are for the package or hours each venue names, so read the row before you book.

faq.q: How much does a small wedding cost in Texas?
faq.a: We do not quote an average. In Houston the venue prices we verified run $197 to $8,900, and the official courthouse fees are $81 for the license plus $100 for a ceremony at Justice of the Peace Precinct 1, Place 1.

faq.q: Is $5,000 enough for a wedding in Houston?
faq.a: For a small group it can be: the cheapest verified venue ($197) plus the sample finds comes to about $2,127, and even the most expensive venue here is $8,900. A 100-guest wedding is a different budget, because this page prices small groups only.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue in Houston?
faq.a: We do not quote an average, because an average hides what each venue actually prints. On this page 11 venues print prices from $197 to $8,900, each quoted from its own website on Oct 28, 2026.
